title: Women Friends, Gustav Klimt, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Two women rest in tender stillness — close to one another, yet each lost in her own thoughts. Klimt captures intimacy expressed not through words or glances, but through posture, gesture, and the fluid lines of golden ornament. This is a delicate scene of suspended closeness — serene, sensual, timeless. The silver coin, adorned with natural amber, reflects this atmosphere as an elegant tribute to the artistry of Viennese Secession.
